title: Reshmi Kabab

ingredients.title: For Marinade 1 – Tenderization
items: Boneless chicken thigh or breast – 700 g, cut into medium cubes

ingredients.title: For Marinade 2 – Creamy Base
items: Thick yogurt or hung curd – ½ cup
Cashew nuts – 8–10, soaked and ground into a smooth paste
Green chilies – 2, finely chopped or made into a paste
Fresh coriander leaves – 2 tbsp, finely chopped
Kasuri methi – 1 tsp, lightly roasted and crushed

instruction.title: Tenderize the Chicken
steps: Wash the chicken pieces and pat them completely dry.
Place the chicken in a bowl and add lemon juice and 1 tsp salt.
Mix thoroughly so all pieces are coated.
Set aside for 20 minutes to tenderize and reduce the raw odor.

instruction.title: Prepare the Creamy Marinade
steps: In a large bowl, combine hung yogurt, fresh cream, and smooth cashew paste.
Add green chili, ginger-garlic paste, white pepper, garam masala, cardamom powder, kasuri methi, and salt.
Add chopped coriander leaves and melted butter.
Mix until the marinade is smooth and evenly combined.

instruction.title: Marinate the Chicken
steps: Add the tenderized chicken to the creamy marinade.
Coat each chicken piece thoroughly.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4–6 hours.
For the best restaurant-style texture and flavor, marinate overnight.

instruction.title: Prepare the Basting Mixture
steps: Combine 2 tbsp melted butter with 1 tbsp fresh cream.
Mix well and keep aside for brushing during cooking.

instruction.title: Cook – Tandoor or Charcoal Grill
steps: Preheat the tandoor or charcoal grill to high heat.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers.
Place the skewers in the hot tandoor or over the grill.
Cook until the chicken is golden, tender, and lightly charred.
Baste occasionally with the butter-cream mixture while cooking.

instruction.title: Cook – Oven Method
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C / 425°F.
Arrange the chicken skewers on a wire rack positioned over a baking tray.
Cook for 12–15 minutes, turning and basting halfway through.
Broil for 2–3 minutes at the end to develop a lightly charred exterior.

instruction.title: Cook – Stovetop Method
steps: Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat and lightly brush with oil.
Place the marinated chicken pieces on the hot pan.
Cook while turning regularly until golden and cooked through.
Baste frequently with the butter-cream mixture for a rich, moist finish.

instruction.title: Optional Smoky Finish
steps: Heat a small piece of charcoal until red-hot.
Place the cooked kababs in a heatproof covered bowl with a small steel bowl inside.
Put the hot charcoal into the steel bowl and add ½ tsp ghee.
Immediately cover the bowl and let the smoke infuse for about 2 minutes.
Remove the charcoal before serving.

instruction.title: Serve
steps: Serve the hot Reshmi Kababs with mint-coriander chutney, onion rings, lemon wedges, and butter naan.
Garnish with a light drizzle of cream and fresh coriander leaves.

chefTips: Chicken: Use boneless chicken thighs for maximum juiciness and tenderness.
Yogurt: Always use thick hung curd to prevent a watery marinade.
Texture: Cashew paste combined with cream creates the characteristic silky, rich Reshmi texture.
Marination: Overnight marination gives the chicken deeper flavor and a softer restaurant-style texture.
Basting: Brush with the butter-cream mixture during cooking to prevent the chicken from drying out.
Cooking: Use high heat for a lightly charred exterior while avoiding overcooking the chicken.
